basic_details.job_title: ACTREC Internship under Scientific Social Responsibility of ANRF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre's Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, has advertised one position for an Internship under Scientific Social Responsibility (SSR) of ANRF, open to students in the 2nd Year of M.Sc. Biotechnology. Applications are sent by email to [email protected], as soft-copy attachments, on or before 15 November 2026. The internship lasts 2 months with a fellowship of Rs. 5,000 per month.

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC)
Internship under Scientific Social Responsibility (SSR) of ANRF
Fellowship of Rs. 5,000/- per month, for 2 months
Students in the 2nd Year of M.Sc. Biotechnology
Translational Research Laboratory, ACTREC-TMC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai
15 November 2026 (soft copies to be sent by email on or before this date)

content_sections.heading: About ACTREC
content_sections.text: ACTREC is part of Tata Memorial Centre, at Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410 210. The notice describes it as a Grant-in-aid Institution of the Dept. of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The internship belongs to the project 'An investigation into the mechanism of cell death-induced inflammation' (Project No. CRG/2023/004470), funded by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), Government of India (formerly SERB), under the Core Research Grant scheme. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Snehal Shabrish, Scientific Officer 'E', Translational Research Laboratory, ACTREC-TMC.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by email only, to [email protected] . The notice does not give an email subject line or a postal address for applications. It states the steps below. Applications incomplete in any respect will not be entertained, and no further correspondence will be made in this regard.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Students in the 2nd Year of M.Sc. Biotechnology. Duration: 2 months. The position is purely temporary, and the selected student is supported by a financial assistantship of Rs. 5,000 per month for 2 months only. Financial support for other activities such as travel, boarding and lodging will not be provided. The student must make their own arrangements for stay during the dissertation period. The Institute does not guarantee on-campus accommodation; if available, it is given on a first cum first served basis. No further extension will be provided in any circumstances. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says the rights of selection are reserved with the institute. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview. As there is only one position, only the selected candidate will be intimated. After successful completion of the dissertation, a certificate will be issued by the PI.

faq.question: Q1. How many positions are open in the ACTREC SSR internship?
faq.answer: One position is open for the Internship under Scientific Social Responsibility (SSR) of ANRF.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ACTREC internship?
faq.answer: Soft copies of the filled application form and documents must be sent by email on or before 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for this ACTREC internship?
faq.answer: Students in the 2nd Year of M.Sc. Biotechnology can apply.

faq.question: Q4. How much fellowship is paid?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 5,000/- per month, for 2 months only.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the ACTREC internship?
faq.answer: Fill out the application form attached to the advertisement and email it to [email protected] with your updated Biodata/CV and scanned copies of degree certificates.

faq.question: Q6. Is a recommendation letter needed?
faq.answer: Yes. A recommendation letter from the institute where you are currently studying must be sent directly to the PI.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent post, and can it be extended?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and only for 2 months, and no further extension will be provided in any circumstances.

faq.question: Q8. Will ACTREC provide travel or accommodation?
faq.answer: Financial support for travel, boarding and lodging will not be provided. On-campus accommodation is not guaranteed; if available, it is given on a first cum first served basis.

faq.question: Q9. Will every applicant be informed about the result?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview, and only the selected candidate will be intimated.
